title: No "Pocket" for Hand
text:
No "Pocket" for Hand. Pros:
1. They look nice, exactly as shown in the picture.
2. Haven't burnt myself yet

Cons: Only one but it's a big one...you don't slip your hand into a "pocket" on the back like 99% of these things typically have (or at least all the ines I own). Makes grabbing for stuff a task.

Conclusion: if you're cool with no "pocket" for your hand then you can't beat this for the price but if you want that hand secured then spend your money else where.
